CarGurus walk stores each listing\\u0027s vehicle-history summary (accidents reported, previous owners, rental use, frame damage) and raises red flags for frame damage, reported accidents, and rental or fleet use.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022From a CarGurus detail page\\u0027s History section and price area, the walk reads and stores on the posting: title wording (\\u0027Clean title\\u0027 or a brand), accident count (\\u0027N accident(s) reported\\u0027), previous-owner count, rental use (\\u0027Reported as previous rental vehicle\\u0027), and frame damage (\\u0027(Frame damage reported)\\u0027); a field the page doesn\\u0027t show is stored as not stated, never as zero or clean.\u0022,\u0022A stored frame-damage statement raises a \\u0027frame-damage\\u0027 red flag; an accident count of one or more raises \\u0027accident-reported\\u0027 naming the count; rental or fleet use raises \\u0027rental-history\\u0027. odo show prints the summary and its source, and rank shows the flags with the other red flags. Exclusion is not part of this task.\u0022,\u0022A CarGurus walk with --revisit refreshes the summary for cars the ledger already holds; if the card on the search page carries any of these fields, the card read stores them too, without a detail visit.\u0022,\u0022Tests use CarGurus detail-page fixtures for a clean car, a car with accidents and rental use, and #152\\u0027s frame-damage page shape; docs/walk.md and docs/research.md describe the fields and flags.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022From the 2026-10-03 shortlist session. On Brian\\u0027s 20-car shortlist, CarGurus showed frame damage on #152 4T1DAACK8SU095738 (also a former rental), accidents on #101 (2), #66, #185 and #19 (1 each), and rental use on #75. Rank showed every one as clean. #19 JTDBCMFE1P3004013\\u0027s free AutoCheck report (notes/autocheck-JTDBCMFE1P3004013.txt in the project home) also shows a police-reported front impact (2024-01) and \\u0027Auction Announced as Frame Damage\\u0027 at a dealer auction (2026-08-28). Reading the full free AutoCheck report (a srcdoc iframe some dealers expose) is out of scope here and may be a later task. Whether frame damage excludes a car is Brian\\u0027s ruling,
